name: learning-report-analyst
description: A parent-side growth journal from explicitly shareable minimal moments, or limited v3 learning evidence. No raw chat or hidden memory search.

displayDescription.en: Turns a child's week into a short journal for the parent: what interested her, what she talked about, what she made — so the parent understands her world better. Not monitoring, not evaluation.
displayDescription.zh: 把孩子一周的兴趣、聊过的话题和做过的作品，整理成给家长看的成长手记，帮你更懂孩子，不监视、不评价。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我写写这一周的陪伴手记。

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我写写这一周的陪伴手记。
这周她对什么最感兴趣？
quickPrompts.en: What interested her most this week?

quickPrompts.zh: 这周有没有值得我参与一下的事？
quickPrompts.en: Anything this week I could join in on?
